journey.name: transfer to spending banner clears when the lsp closes the channel
journey.description:
Covers issue #614. A pending Transfer to Spending keeps its "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner across an app restart while the node starts, and a transfer whose channel the LSP later closes does not leave a banner behind or inflate the Spending balance.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet (staging regtest) with a positive on-chain Savings balance and a running node connected to the LSP. Start on the wallet home screen. The LSP only opens the channel after the order payment has one confirmation, so the transfer stays pending until a block is mined; other staging users can mine that block for you, so do the restart steps promptly.
Transfer orders are zero-conf, so on an unmodified build the transfer settles as soon as the channel is ready and the closed-channel settle path is not reached on its own. This journey then checks that nothing is left behind after the close. Reaching the closed-channel path on a device needs a temporary local change that skips the channel-ready settle; it was verified that way for issue #614 and is covered by TransferRepoTest.kt.
The close moves the transfer amount back to Savings minus fees, so the wallet ends close to its starting balances.

actions.action: Note the Spending balance shown on the home screen (testTag "ActivitySpending")
Tap the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings")
Tap "Transfer To Spending" (testTag "TransferToSpending")
If the spending intro screen appears, tap its button (testTag "SpendingIntro-button")
Verify the spending amount screen (testTag "SpendingAmount") is visible
Wait until the available amount (testTag "SpendingAmountUnit") shows a positive value
Tap the "5" key (testTag "N5") enough times to enter an amount the LSP accepts (50000 sats is a safe value), then tap Continue (testTag "SpendingAmountContinue")
Swipe "Swipe To Transfer" to confirm
Tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (testTag "TransferSuccess-button")
Verify the purple "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner is visible on the home screen (screenshot; the banner carries no testTag)
Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev, then launch the app again
Wait for the home screen and for the node to start (app log line "Node started")
Verify the purple "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner is still visible (screenshot)
Read the order id from the app log: the active TO_SPENDING transfer's "lspOrderId" in the latest "Active transfers at block height" line
Run ./lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":1}'
Poll ./lsp GET /channels/<lspOrderId> until channel.state is "open", and note channel.fundingTx.id and channel.fundingTx.vout
Tap the OK button (testTag "TransferSuccess-button") if the Transfer Successful screen is shown; its label is randomized ("Great!", "Nice!", …)
Run ./lsp POST /regtest/channel/close '{"fundingTxId":"<fundingTx.id>","vout":<fundingTx.vout>,"forceCloseAfterSec":0}'
Run ./lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":3}'
Wait for the "Connection Closed" sheet and tap OK (testTag "ConnectionClosedButton")
Verify no "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner is visible on the home screen (screenshot)
Verify the Spending balance (testTag "ActivitySpending") matches the value noted in the first step
Verify the app log has a "Settled transfer" line naming the closed channel, and that the latest "Active transfers at block height" line lists no TO_SPENDING transfer
